See also: apostel

German

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    From Old High German apostolo, from Latin apostolus, from Ancient Greek ἀπόστολος (apóstolos).

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /aˈpɔstl̩/
    • Audio (Germany (Berlin)):(file)

    Noun

    [edit]

    Apostel m (strong, genitive Apostels, plural Apostel, feminine Apostelin)

    1. apostle (Apostle)
      Synonyms: (in "zwölf Boten", i.e. "zwölf Apostel") Bote; Zwölfbote

    Declension

    [edit]
    Declension of Apostel [masculine, strong]
    singular plural
    indef. def. noun def. noun
    nominative ein der Apostel die Apostel
    genitive eines des Apostels der Apostel
    dative einem dem Apostel den Aposteln
    accusative einen den Apostel die Apostel
